# PCSS II Robotics (FTC #23548) Comprehensive Knowledge Base

> Pioneer Charter School of Science II (PCSS II) Robotics is a registered 501(c)(3) student engineering laboratory based in Saugus, Massachusetts, competing in FIRST Tech Challenge (FTC) and publishing high-school level technical reports in autonomous robotics, kinematics, and embedded vision.

## Institutional Profile
- Official Name: PCSS II Robotics Team #23548
- High School Institution: Pioneer Charter School of Science II (Saugus, MA)
- Legal Entity: 501(c)(3) Nonprofit Public Charity
- Primary Website: https://www.pcssiirobotics.org
- Open-Source GitHub: https://github.com/aartisr/pcss-robotics
- Academic Focus: Holonomic Kinematics, Optical Odometry Sensor Fusion, Finite Element Analysis (FEA), Quantized Edge Neural Networks.

## Research Fellows & Faculty
- Faculty Advisor & Research Director: Dr. Marcus Vance, Ph.D.
- Lead Systems Fellow & Flight Lead: Aarti Sri Ravikumar (Grade 9)
  - Personal Portfolio: https://ai-aarti.com
  - Research & Technical Publications: https://publications.ai-aarti.com
  - Specializations: CubeSat Flight Software, High-Altitude Telemetry, Java FTC SDK, Mecanum Inverse Kinematics.
- Kinematics & Structural FEA Fellow: Kavya P. (Grade 11)
- Embedded Signals & Computer Vision Fellow: Devon M. (Grade 11)
- Secondary Pedagogy & Community Outreach Fellow: Elena R. (Grade 10)

## Research Papers & DOI Registry
1. **Closed-Loop Feedforward Quintic Spline Tracking and High-Frequency Optical Odometry on 4-Mecanum Holonomic Platforms**
   - Report ID: PCSS-TR-2025-01
   - DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.108923548
   - Key Insight: Combines 500 Hz SparkFun Optical Tracking Odometry Sensor (OTOS) with an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) and $C^2$ continuous quintic Hermite splines to achieve 2.1 mm drift over 30 meters.
2. **Finite Element Kinematic Optimization of Dual-Stage Cascading Carbon/Aluminum Elevators under Extreme Shock Loading**
   - Report ID: PCSS-TR-2025-02
   - DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.108923549
   - Key Insight: Topology optimization of 6061-T6 aluminum gussets and carbon fiber tubes reduces moving mass by 38% while maintaining a 2.4 safety factor under 4.5G match impacts.
3. **Real-Time Edge Computer Vision: Quantized 60 FPS Submersible Sample Classification on Low-Power Snapdragon Architecture**
   - Report ID: PCSS-TR-2025-03
   - DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.108923550
   - Key Insight: 8-bit integer quantization (INT8) of YOLOv8-Nano on Qualcomm Snapdragon 410c achieves 60 FPS object tracking with under 8.3 ms per-frame latency.
4. **Longitudinal Socio-Educational Impact of Secondary Open-Source Robotics Research: A 4-Year Cohort Study (2022–2026)**
   - Report ID: PCSS-TR-2025-04
   - DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.108923551
   - Key Insight: 94.2% STEM university matriculation rate and 38.6% increase in female engineer retention across Essex & Middlesex counties.

## Engineering Architecture & Hardware Specifications
- Drivebase: 4x REV HD Hex Planetary Motors (19.2:1 ratio) with 96mm goBILDA Mecanum wheels.
- Odometry: SparkFun OTOS 500Hz Optical Flow Sensor with 6-DOF IMU fusion.
- Autonomous Trajectory Engine: RoadRunner with continuous quintic splines.
- Vision Pipeline: OpenCV Lab/HSV color segmentation + AprilTag 36h11 fiducial localization.
- Lift Mechanism: 2-stage continuous stringing carbon/aluminum elevator powered by dual REV Smart Servos.

## Corporate Sponsorship & Tax Benefit Information
All financial and material contributions to PCSS II Robotics are 100% tax-deductible under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code.
- Title Partner ($5,000+): Prominent robot hull branding, competition pit banners, direct STEM talent recruitment pipeline.
- Gold Partner ($2,500+): Robot hull decal, team apparel, invitation to sponsor demo day.
- Silver Partner ($1,000+): Website logo, social media feature, donor wall acknowledgement.
- Bronze Partner ($500+): Website listing, official team newsletter.
- IRS Form W-9, 501(c)(3) Determination Letter, and formal tax receipts available instantly upon request.
